primitives.name: API Key Parser
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Files | File | Purpose | | --- | --- | | `apps/web/lib/api/v1/api-key.ts` | Parses `Authorization: Bearer`, `X-GSE-API-Key`, or `X-API-Key`; hashes keys with SHA-256 namespace; rejects missing, malformed, invalid-scheme, and conflicting credentials.
primitives.assumptions: Assumes input headers are correctly formatted strings; operates on opaque binary data without decoding scheme knowledge.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Rejects any input producing a SHA-256 collision or violating header format constraints.

layer2.mapping: Maps to a conformal prediction kernel that validates API key syntax and structure before any downstream processing, ensuring zero false positives in credential rejection.
layer2.telemetry: Rate of rejected requests per second, distinguishing between malformed headers and invalid credentials.

primitives.verbatim_quote: | | `apps/web/lib/api/v1/scopes.ts` | Defines the first shadow endpoints and their required scopes.
primitives.assumptions: Assumes each endpoint has a fixed set of permitted scopes that are known at compile time.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Fails closed if an endpoint's requested scope exceeds its defined whitelist.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to a Bayesian network that tracks the probability of a request being authorized given its claimed scope versus the ground-truth endpoint permissions.
layer2.telemetry: Ratio of allowed versus denied requests, stratified by scope overlap and endpoint type.

primitives.name: Payload Rights Checker
primitives.verbatim_quote: | | `apps/web/lib/api/v1/payload-rights.ts` | Reuses the FABLE source registry adapter and blocks API exposure when display, storage, partner-sharing, or training rights do not pass.
primitives.assumptions: Assumes the FABLE registry contains a complete and accurate record of all content rights associated with a given payload.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Blocks all traffic if any required right (display, storage, sharing, training) is absent or expired for the payload's identifier.

layer2.mapping: Maps to a conformal hypothesis test that verifies the presence of necessary data-use licenses before allowing payload transmission, preventing legal breaches.
layer2.telemetry: Percentage of requests blocked due to missing or expired rights, segmented by right category.

primitives.assumptions: Assumes all outputs must be structured as a fixed-format JSON object containing exactly these fields, regardless of payload size.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Returns an empty `data` field and populates `errors` if any validation step upstream fails.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to a fail-closed encoder that wraps all API responses in a standardized, verifiable container, enabling automated error detection and replay prevention.
layer2.telemetry: Average envelope size in bytes, median latency of envelope construction, and proportion of envelopes carrying error messages.
